Researchers observed a new campaign using AI-generated phishing emails targeting
defense industrial base contractors. The lures were authored with an LLM and bypassed
several legacy detection signatures. The campaign delivered a malicious .docm via
hxxps://invoice-portal[.]example[.]com/po-2026-0517.docm.

Defenders should treat prompt injection as a relevant adversarial AI threat and consider
agentic AI abuse in scenario planning.
